name: find_tools
description: Find a tool by what you want to do, across all 231 — including the ones whose toolset is off. Ask "autotile a tilemap" or "record input" and get the matching names, a one-line summary each, and the toolset to enable. Use this when you know what you want to DO but not what it is called; list_toolsets is for browsing.

include_schema.description: Also return each match's full inputSchema. Default false — the names and summaries are usually enough to pick one.

limit.description: How many matches to return (1-40, default 8).

query.description: What you are trying to do, in your own words (e.g. "bake a navmesh", "read the player position while the game runs").
